title: My New Flashcard
text:
This is my new flashcard. It has a picture of a cat. The word on the card is cat.

I show the card to my mom. She says the word too. Then we put the card in the box.

questions.text: Who does the speaker show the card to?
Why does the speaker show the card to mom?
Where does the speaker probably keep the flashcards?

vocabulary.definition: a small piece of stiff paper
a container with sides and a lid

paragraph_translations: Bu benim yeni kartım. Üzerinde bir kedinin resmi var. Karttaki kelime cat.
Kartı anneme gösteriyorum. O da kelimeyi söylüyor. Sonra kartı kutuya koyuyoruz.
